Closed Fridays, Sundays and public holidays. 10-week terms, 4 a year.

items.name: BK's Gymnastics Caroline Springs
facts: Programs: Baby ROO (0–2), Little Stars (1–5), GymbaROO (2–8), Gym FUNdamentals (5–8), Ninja Stars (5–10+) and Club Gym (8–13+).
50% off enrolment advertised (11 Nov 2026); free centre tours on request.
Serves families from Burnside, Burnside Heights, Cairnlea, Caroline Springs, Deer Park, Delahey and Derrimut, as listed.

items.name: Gymnastics Unlimited Australia
items.address: 3/4 Waigani Ave, Ravenhall VIC 3023 (second venue in Kealba)
facts: Non-competitive recreational program for boys and girls aged 5 to 15, drawing on artistic, acrobatic and trampoline gymnastics.
Level 1 (5–7 years) is a 1-hour class each week; Level 2 (7–10 years) extends to 1½ hours.
Gymnasts are assessed within the club at the end of each term; kids can move into competitive classes when ready.
Many new gymnasts progress from the Kinder Gym program.

items.name: JUMP! Swim Schools Caroline Springs
facts: JUMP! describes this as a new location: boutique learn-to-swim lessons for babies from 3 months, children and adults in a warm, purpose-built indoor pool.
Classes run 7 days a week, with morning and afternoon sessions, and group and private lessons.
Levels run from Baby Water Play (3–6 months) and Duckling (6–10 months) to Marlin stroke development.

items.name: State Swim Caroline Springs
items.hours: Mon 9am–8.30pm; Tue 8.30am–8.30pm; Wed 9am–9pm; Thu 9am–8pm; Fri 8.30am–8pm; Sat 6.30am–1.30pm; Sun 8.30am–1.30pm
facts: Programs include Swim & Play (6 months+), Waterbabies (6 months–2.5 years) and adult learn-to-swim (18+).
Address: 16-24 The Crossing, Caroline Springs VIC 3023.
State Swim says it has taught swimming for more than 50 years across Perth, Adelaide and Melbourne.

items.name: Little Swimmers Swim School Deer Park
facts: Address: 161 Radnor Drive, Deer Park VIC 3023; free trial bookings online.
Swimming Babies program from 3 months to 3 years, with Mum or Dad in the water (per the Little Swimmers website).
Boutique centre with a maximum of two classes in the pool at any one time (per the Little Swimmers website).

items.name: Melton Waves Learn to Swim
items.hours: Centre: Mon–Fri 5am–9pm; Sat, Sun and public holidays 8am–6pm. Gym open 24/7.

facts: The club's football page lists Little Legends, a School Holiday Soccer Camp and YPL boys teams from U13 to U18.
Expressions of interest are open for 2027 girls players.

items.name: Melton Basketball
facts: For junior domestic competition vacancies, families contact the clubs directly. Melton Basketball lists 14 junior domestic clubs.
Examples: Caroline Springs Basketball Academy trains Mondays at Caroline Springs Leisure Centre; Knights and Spartans train at Melton Indoor Recreation Centre.
Clubs train at different venues across Melton, from Thornhill Park Primary to Cobblebank Stadium, and most list a contact email or Facebook page.

items.name: St Albans Caroline Springs Netball Association
Caroline Springs Tennis Club
items.address: Caroline Springs Leisure Centre, 9-19 The Parade, Caroline Springs 3023
facts: Local club offering tennis coaching, senior and junior competition and recreational tennis for members.
Also runs coaching for local schools and for people with special needs.
New enquiries and members welcome; website carolinespringstc.com.au.

items.name: Kurunjang Park Tennis Club
facts: Group and private lessons run Monday to Friday through Kelly Gang Tennis Coaching.
WRTA Junior tennis: competitive, every Saturday morning, for members under 18 (1 set of singles and 2 sets of doubles, teams of 3).
Club members of all ages can also play the MTTA Open Twilight competition on Wednesday nights from 7pm.

items.name: Stephanie's House of Dance
items.ages: Kinder Dance 3–4; ballet, jazz and hip-hop 5+
items.days: Classes run at Caroline Springs and Keilor Downs
items.hours: Mon 4.30–7.30pm and Tue 4–5.30pm (Keilor Downs); Wed 4–9pm and Thu 4–8.30pm (Caroline Springs)
facts: Dance classes for ages 2 years and up, plus an adult dance fitness class; 2026 enrolments open.
Jazz (5+) covers warm-ups, stretches, floor progressions and choreography.
Ballet (5+) focuses on foot positions, posture and arm alignment.
Hip-hop classes use current hip-hop and RnB tracks.

items.name: Tiny Tutus (Caroline Springs and Taylors Hill)
facts: Classes by age: Teeny (1.5–2.5 years, danced with a grown-up), Tiny Tots (2–3), Pre-Ballet (3–4), Ballet (4–5) and Elementary (5–8, adding jazz and lyrical).
Weekend and afternoon classes are available; trials and enrolment are booked online.
The end-of-year recital runs for around an hour, designed for little ones.

items.name: Kinderballet Taylors Lakes

items.name: Stage School Australia Caroline Springs
items.address: Stevenson House, 10 Stevenson Crescent, Caroline Springs
facts: Performing arts classes for 4–7 year olds, run by term: one class a week of 1.5 to 2.25 hours.
Saturdays: Foundation and Beginners OnStage rehearsals. Class divisions are based strictly on birthdate.
Next classes start February 2027; auditions for the Melbourne 4-Year-Old Foundation Program are scheduled for February 2027.
There's a car park next door and street parking in Stevenson Crescent.

items.name: WestEnd Performing Arts
facts: Dance studio based in Sunshine with classes from 18 months to adult, for fun or for students seeking a dance career through Elite Training Programs.
Age groups listed: Tinies (18 months–5 years), Minis (5–6), Petite (6–8), Junior (8–10), Pre Teen (10–12), Teen (12–14), Senior (15+) and adult classes.
Ready Set Dance is a one-hour combo class of jazz, tap, hip hop, singing and music.
Free trial class offered.

items.name: Galactic Dance
facts: Classes listed on the site include Aerial Arts and Ready Set Dance.
Trial classes can be booked online.
Families can visit the studio to meet the instructors before enrolling.

items.name: Samurai Karate Caroline Springs
items.price: $49 for 2 weeks' training plus a free uniform (intro offer)
facts: Age-banded classes: Little Samurai (4–7), Juniors (8–15) and Adults (16+). Traditional Shukokai karate with self-defence.
Little Samurai classes run for 40 minutes (9–9.40am or 5.30–6.10pm on the timetable).
Junior classes (8–14 on the timetable) are grouped by belt: Novice (white to yellow), Intermediate (orange to blue) and Advanced (purple and above).

items.name: GKR Karate Melton Prime
facts: Free, obligation-free trial class: send your details and an instructor contacts you with class times and fees.
From age 5, GKR teaches basic self-defence and extraction moves.
Membership lets you train at any GKR location.
GKR says it has been established for over 40 years.

items.name: Shindo Karate Melton
items.ages: Little Ninjas and Mighty Ninjas 4–6; junior classes by belt
items.days: Tue & Thu at Staughton College; Wed & Sat at Murrum Primary School; Fri at Arnolds Creek Primary School
facts: Classes run 5 days a week across three Melton schools, led by Sempai Annie Noble (2nd Dan, Level 2 NCAS coach).
Class groups: Little Ninjas (4–6, white to red/blue belt), Mighty Ninjas (4–6, red belt and above), then Junior Beginners, Intermediate and Advanced by belt.
New students can register for 2 free lessons.

items.name: Hall's Taekwondo Sunshine
facts: Taekwondo centre established in 2008, with classes for 4–6 year olds, 7–14 year olds and 15 and over.
A $9 intro offer is advertised.
Students can cross-train at any Hall's Taekwondo centre.

items.name: Caroline Springs School of Music
items.ages: Toddlers (Bambino Beats 10 months–4 years) to adults
facts: Bambino Beats is the school's toddler music program for children aged 10 months to 4 years, in small groups.
Toddlers are introduced to a range of instruments, with Curwen hand-sign and solfege singing drawing on Kodaly, Orff and Dalcroze methods.
All students are encouraged to perform at the end-of-year concert.

items.name: The Music Hub Academy
facts: Describes itself as Melton's oldest running music school, teaching all ages and abilities.
Lessons cover drums, guitar, bass, ukulele and banjo, piano and violin, with chances to perform on stage.

items.name: Trill Music Studio
facts: Singing and piano/keyboard lessons in Caroline Springs, private or in groups, plus online lessons. Founded in 2008.
Group piano/keyboard lessons have 3–5 students.
Students can prepare for AMEB and ANZCA exams, and the studio holds half-yearly and end-of-year concerts.
All teachers hold a current Working with Children Check.

items.name: Mini Maestros Caroline Springs
items.address: Springside Community Centre, Becca Way, Caroline Springs
facts: Music classes for babies, toddlers and preschoolers aged 6 months to 5 years at Springside Community Centre, Becca Way.
Children sing, dance, play percussion instruments and musical games, in a planned, sequential program.
The program introduces beat, rhythm, dynamics, form and notation, and supports speech, listening, social and physical skills.

facts: Kids' classes run on Mondays and Fridays, with different styles each day and a discount for attending both.
Classes run every week, even during school holidays. Styles include ballroom, Latin, New Vogue, street Latin, ballet, jazz and lyrical.
Tiny Dancers is on Fridays at 4.30pm for children who walk independently.
Casual classes with no joining fees; off-street parking and an enclosed garden area.

A free trial lesson can be booked at any Melbourne Kingswim centre.
Squad swimming follows the learn-to-swim program, and adult lessons are also offered.
